responsibility: This module is GCC’s target backend for TI MSP430 microcontrollers, covering both driver-time device selection and the compiler’s MSP430 code-generation pipeline. Its core backend files define the target description, options, custom 20-bit pointer/integer mode support, calling convention, frame layout, assembly formatting, and RTL expansion/selection for MSP430 and MSP430X instructions, including constraints, predicates, and machine-description patterns that encode addressing limits, near/far memory behavior, shifts, branches, prologues/epilogues, and hardware-multiply handling. Supporting device-database files translate -mmcu and related options into concrete ISA revision, multiplier capabilities, support-file paths, and diagnostics, while the driver hooks propagate MSP430-specific multilib, library, and linker-region decisions. The module also exposes C-family address-space qualifiers such as __near and __far, making this directory the complete target-specific layer that maps generic GCC compilation onto MSP430 architectural rules, memory models, runtime support selection, and final assembly emission.
